synthesizedFacts.fact: Exfoliating jelly cleansers often combine AHA and BHA acids to provide deep cleansing and exfoliation without abrasive scrubs.
These cleansers can remove makeup, including water-resistant formulas, and help control oily skin by clearing pores.
Exfoliating jelly cleansers are often formulated to be gentle enough for sensitive skin and are free from harsh chemicals like parabens.
Ingredients like goat milk and seaweed are used for their nourishing and moisturizing properties.
